title: Cloud Security: signed application
content:
Cloud Security signed application is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The signed application request has an approved service review.

The customer signs and submits the application through a supported request channel.

Create status applied and opening date from the frozen clock, with no consumption or charge.

The requested tier supplies maximum provisioned resource count; reject unsupported regions, unsupported currency, resource counts above that limit, and unapproved contract terms without a write.

The customer owns the signature; an agent cannot sign for them.

Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application fields copied into the proposed holding.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable open action, authoritative system records must establish: The signed application request has an approved service review. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference, customer request reference.

For every Security tier, the signed application must have approved contract terms, a resource count no greater than that tier’s maximum, and a service region supported by that tier’s regional usage multipliers.

## Basis Q&A

**Whose records establish the admission facts?**

Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application fields copied into the proposed holding.

## Customer signature

Hypothetical case: an agent offers to sign the application on the customer’s behalf. The agent cannot provide that signature.
